name: Aave Savings GHO
oneLiner: sGHO is Aave's savings wrapper of GHO; deposit GHO to earn the Aave governance-set savings rate in GHO, with GHO-tier CDP risk underneath.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 25573280, sGHO asset() returned GHO 0x40D16FC0246aD3160Ccc09B8D0D3A2cD28aE6C2f. The wrapper's EIP-1967 implementation slot resolved to 0xff229a0bbb614a284de8ae0e41e5974878fd7c04 and its admin slot to ProxyAdmin 0xc15700631020eba02317964550365b95a9a28adb. ProxyAdmin.owner() returned the Aave Governance V3 Level-1 Executor 0x5300A1a15135EA4dc7aD5a167152C01EFc9b192A. The current wrapper implementation has ordinary ERC-20 transfers and no live holder blacklist, pause, seizure, or privileged holder-burn surface. Proxy upgrade authority remains reviewed in Mint Authority and does not create a direct FreezeWatch finding. sGHO therefore retains upstream-only status through its tracked GHO parent.

mintAuthority.summary: sGHO is a savings wrapper over GHO; wrapper minting is share accounting while durable GHO mint authority is inherited from reviewed Aave facilitator controls.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25573280, asset() on the recorded sGHO token returned GHO 0x40D16FC0246aD3160Ccc09B8D0D3A2cD28aE6C2f. The wrapper is an EIP-1967 transparent proxy with implementation 0xff229a0bbb614a284de8ae0e41e5974878fd7c04 and ProxyAdmin 0xc15700631020eba02317964550365b95a9a28adb. Its ProxyAdmin owner is the Aave Governance V3 Level-1 Executor 0x5300A1a15135EA4dc7aD5a167152C01EFc9b192A. Shares are local deposit accounting; durable GHO issuance remains inherited from the reviewed parent. No named prudential supervisor applies to the wrapper.

collateral: GHO deposited into Aave's ERC-4626 sGHO savings vault on Ethereum; share value accrues a governance-set fixed APR with no cooldown, no slashing, and no rehypothecation of deposited funds.
pegMechanism: Deposit GHO into the ERC-4626 sGHO vault to mint sGHO shares; the share-to-GHO exchange rate rises as the Aave-governance-set savings rate accrues. The vault's `asset()` is GHO and standard ERC-4626 `convertToAssets()` / `totalAssets()` reads expose NAV per share. Pharos prices this entry from the vault's share exchange rate rather than secondary-market liquidity.

oracleRisk.summary: sGHO is an ERC-4626 savings wrapper over GHO and has no borrower-owned collateral positions or token-level liquidation engine. Its underlying GHO exposure inherits the external Aave reserve-oracle risk reviewed on the parent asset.

branchApplicability.rationale: Aave documents sGHO as a savings vault where users deposit GHO and withdraw GHO against an accruing share value. sGHO holders do not open Aave borrower positions, so there are no sGHO collateral-market or liquidation branches to inventory; the underlying GHO parent carries the separate Aave oracle profile.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No material unclassified reserve exposure is present; sGHO inherits GHO protocol and facilitator risk.
